name: Standard Implementation: Event Store Filtering and CLI
prompt:
Coordinate a multi-file change across models.py, store.py, cli.py, and test_event_store.py:
R1: In models.py and store.py, add support for event timestamp range filtering in EventStore.query_by_type(event_type, start_time=None, end_time=None).
R2: In cli.py, update the query command to accept optional --start and --end timestamp arguments.
R3: Add unit tests in test_event_store.py asserting timestamp filtering correctness and boundary edge cases.
R4: All tests must pass with python3 -m unittest discover -s . -v.
Allowed paths: models.py, store.py, cli.py, test_event_store.py.
